mapping_basis.hml_ontology: Gold-125 ontology-v1: 17 KEEP_AS_CORE candidates plus unresolved INDUCT candidate
mapping_basis.minilang: Ten paper semantic operations, not the larger executable command registry
mapping_basis.warning: The compared units differ. HML candidates factor operation, warrant, goal/scope/epistemic effects, while MiniLang commands often compose those axes and delegate mathematical work to Isabelle.

hml_axes.dependencies: introduced assumptions support all descendants in scope
hml_axes.state_delta: fix variables, name premises, strip leading HHF

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: HML should not add INTRO as a mathematical primitive; retain explicit binder/scope effects.

hml_axes.obligations: one proof debt per stated lemma
hml_axes.dependencies: certified lemma records exact proof/context ancestry
hml_axes.state_delta: insert lemma goals; after closure add verified local facts

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: Evidence that goal creation, fact introduction, discharge, and scope should compose; not evidence for a monolithic HAVE kernel opcode.

hml_axes.obligations: explicit exhaustiveness and every branch goal
hml_axes.dependencies: branch results remain local; joined theorem depends on coverage and all branches
hml_axes.state_delta: replace goal with coverage plus branch bundle; later reconstruct parent theorem

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: Strong independent evidence for HML's missing certified branch/join object; MiniLang obtains safety from a kernel theorem, not from CASE_SPLIT spelling alone.

hml_axes.preconditions: fresh typed variables and object-logic proposition
hml_axes.dependencies: witness properties depend on existence proof and enclosing context
hml_axes.state_delta: prove existence; add local witness variables/facts to original goal

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: Do not conflate existential elimination with HML SELECT or candidate promotion.

hml_axes.warrant: named theorem/rule and inferred intro-elim-dest mode
hml_axes.dependencies: rule identity, supplied facts, and generated premises
hml_axes.state_delta: replace current goal by rule premises

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: Supports keeping theorem identity as warrant/library evidence; contradiction/discharge remain effects of rule application.

hml_axes.state_delta: replace existential goal by witness-specific goal

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: MiniLang lacks HML's independent PROPOSED/UNVERIFIED/VERIFIED/REJECTED candidate lifecycle; CHOOSE is not evidence that SELECT and VERIFY should disappear.

hml_axes.warrant: active simp theorem set and tactic proof
hml_axes.preconditions: well-typed goal and applicable simplifier configuration
hml_axes.obligations: residual subgoals; internal side conditions may be hidden by tactic proof
hml_axes.dependencies: simp set, WITH/WITHOUT facts, backend trace/proof term
hml_axes.state_delta: replace goal with checked simplified residual(s)

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: Does not show that all named HML effects are redundant; it shows a broad verified backend interface can implement several effects. HML must preserve warrant/dependency visibility that SIMP's surface hides.

hml_axes.dependencies: case theorem and every branch proof
hml_axes.state_delta: replace goal with tactic-generated case bundle

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: The safe semantics live in Isabelle Rule_Cases and theorem export. HML needs equivalent certificates, not merely the operation name.

hml_axes.dependencies: induction theorem, case assumptions, every branch
hml_axes.state_delta: replace goal with induction case bundle

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: Raises targeted priority for HML's induction protocol experiment but does not prove INDUCT is a primitive; MiniLang delegates the hard schema/generalization work to Isabelle.

hml_axes.warrant: Isabelle-checked Sledgehammer* proof or already-solved kernel goal
hml_axes.preconditions: current goal provable and expected delimiter matches stack
hml_axes.dependencies: selected premises, generated proof, enclosing callback
hml_axes.state_delta: remove solved leaf, collapse block, move to sibling/parent/terminal

minilang_to_hml.collapse_implication: Supports factoring DISCHARGE from mathematical operations and keeping checker-owned status; does not justify hiding proof evidence behind an opaque END.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: INTRO, CONSIDER_EXISTS, HAVE structured fixes, or DEFINE escape hatch
hml_to_minilang.note: No general neutral object-declaration operation in the ten.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: INTRO premises, completed HAVE, or CONSIDER witness/case facts
hml_to_minilang.note: Only proof-context facts; external/given provenance is mostly inherited from Isabelle context.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: Not represented as a proof operation; formal model already exists in Isabelle terms/context
hml_to_minilang.note: Source-distribution/phase difference, not necessarily a language defect.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: CHOOSE for existential witnesses; terms in HAVE; DEFINE escape hatch
SIMP, RULE, APPLY/UNFOLD escape hatches, or END automation
hml_to_minilang.note: Transformation kind/warrant is collapsed into backend configuration.
No first-class substitution command among the ten.
Definition identity may appear as a fact hint.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: RULE; also SIMP/END WITH theorem hints

hml_to_minilang.note: MiniLang additionally relies on explicit/kernel-certified coverage and joins.
Finite collection generation is not independently represented.
Counting is mathematical library content, not MiniLang control.
No value-result/certificate interface distinct from proof closure.
Bounding is proposition content, not control.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: CHOOSE only when supplying an existential witness
Implicit in Isabelle checking and END; explicit goal may be stated with HAVE
hml_to_minilang.note: No separate candidate/claim verification status transition.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: RULE proof_by_contradiction followed by proof operations
hml_to_minilang.note: Contradiction is a theorem/rule and resulting scope/goal effect.

hml_to_minilang.minilang_expression: END/NEXT or any RULE/SIMP that solves a goal
hml_to_minilang.note: Strong evidence DISCHARGE is primarily a goal/control effect.
MiniLang delegates schema/generalization/case semantics to Isabelle; targeted HML protocol evidence is still needed.

semantic_firewall.evidence: Kernel theorems and contexts carry logical premises, but MiniLang surface/JSONL does not expose a neutral dependency graph.
Proof-tree contexts, BLOCK, Rule_Cases, Obtain exports, fixed variables, and named local facts.
The Isar translator is source-specific and emits MiniLang; it is not a representation-neutral corpus adapter.
Type/rule/tactic applicability is checked, but domain preconditions are theorem hypotheses rather than uniform first-class records.
Goals/subgoals persist in the proof tree and must close; semantic metadata/provenance round-trip is less explicit.
CHOOSE refines an existential goal; there is no PROPOSED/UNVERIFIED/VERIFIED/REJECTED lifecycle.
Witness proof checking exists, but no generic candidate promotion transition exists.
CONSIDER_OR constructs a disjunction-elimination theorem; CASE_SPLIT/INDUCT use Isabelle case/induction theorems and branch exports.
Kernel theorems/tactic proofs are authoritative; the serialized corpus omits a uniform evidence object.
RULE, simp sets, theorem libraries, premise selection, Sledgehammer* and external provers supply knowledge.
Goals close only from Isabelle theorem values; failures do not promote claims.
END/NEXT use Goal.conclude/finalize and enforce stack completion.
HOL types, contexts, term checking, theorem instantiation, and exports enforce types; mathematical domains remain propositions/classes.
Theorem hypotheses, type classes, simp/rule applicability and automation discharge domain facts; no generic domain contract.
The artifact's training corpus is concrete text; the later external AoA work supplies AST/JSON separation, not this OOPSLA artifact itself.

bottom_line.convergence: Both projects support a small execution/control interface over rich state, libraries, automation, and a checker.
bottom_line.strongest_disagreement: MiniLang intentionally collapses warrants, dependencies, preconditions, process quality, candidates, and backend behavior behind Isabelle commands; HML's research object requires those axes to remain recoverable.
bottom_line.interpretation_of_list: They may remain stable semantic interface values, but MiniLang strengthens the case for implementing them as compositions, goal/epistemic effects, or library/backend calls rather than dedicated syntax/kernel instructions.
